description: Public/research dataset registry for filling J-POP / City Pop / Anime Song gaps. Audio must stay outside this repository; only features and references are persisted.

sources.name: RWC Music Database: Popular Music Database
sources.recommendedUse: formal training after user obtains the dataset and places audio on external storage

targetGenres.notes: Use Japanese-lyrics popular music style tracks from RWC-MDB-P-2001.

sources.why: Official research dataset with Japanese popular music-style songs and cleared research-use rights.

sources.name: RWC Music Database: Music Genre Database
sources.recommendedUse: macro/fine balancing for popular, rock, dance, jazz, Latin, classical, world, vocals, and traditional Japanese music

targetGenres.genre: ワールドミュージック

sources.why: Contains genre-balanced pieces and can improve macro boundaries once acquired.

sources.name: AnimeTAB
sources.recommendedUse: metadata/symbolic reference for anime/game music structure; not formal audio features unless paired with licensed audio
sources.why: Anime/game music-oriented dataset, but it is tablature/MusicXML rather than source audio.

sources.name: J-POP singing techniques annotation dataset
sources.recommendedUse: feature design reference for vocal/J-POP traits; not formal audio training unless user supplies licensed local audio
sources.why: Real J-POP annotation work, useful for vocal feature design, but based on commercial songs.

sources.name: Openverse/Jamendo reviewed VOCALOID subset
sources.recommendedUse: small Anime Song supplement only; keep manually reviewed
sources.why: Currently only a small number of high-confidence VOCALOID/Jamendo candidates passed review.

sources.name: Explicit City Pop / Anime Song Review Queue
sources.recommendedUse: promote only exact, manually approved, locally available audio rows into formal training

targetGenres.notes: Keep strict. Do not map future funk, synthpop, AOR, or Japanese boogie to exact city-pop without explicit source labels.
Keep strict. Vocaloid, game music, anime house, and symbolic-only sources are adjacent/reference unless explicitly licensed and labeled as anime song.

sources.why: These two labels are sparse and easy to corrupt with adjacent music. The queue preserves exact/adjacent separation and requires review before formal import.
